queries.sql: SELECT id, path, lines, language FROM lightning.metastore.cartograph.provenance.source_file WHERE repo_id = 'siddarth-ba-72/Interview-Prep-Pilot-AI' ORDER BY path

SELECT lo.file_id, lo.line_start, lo.line_end, lo.commit_sha, c.subject, c.body, c.author_name,
            CAST(c.authored_at AS string) AS authored_at, c.url AS commit_url, c.pr_id
     FROM lightning.metastore.cartograph.provenance.line_origin lo JOIN lightning.metastore.cartograph.provenance.code_change c ON c.sha = lo.commit_sha
     WHERE lo.file_id = 'siddarth-ba-72/Interview-Prep-Pilot-AI:ai-service/app/llm.py' AND lo.line_end >= 26 AND lo.line_start <= 26
     ORDER BY c.authored_at DESC

SELECT id, number, title, body, author, CAST(merged_at AS string) AS merged_at, url, issue_count, discussion_count
     FROM lightning.metastore.cartograph.provenance.pull_request WHERE id IN ('siddarth-ba-72/Interview-Prep-Pilot-AI#6')

SELECT i.id, i.number, i.title, i.body, i.labels, i.state, i.url, l.pr_id, l.relation
     FROM lightning.metastore.cartograph.provenance.pr_issue l JOIN lightning.metastore.cartograph.provenance.issue i ON i.id = l.issue_id
     WHERE l.pr_id IN ('siddarth-ba-72/Interview-Prep-Pilot-AI#6')

SELECT id, parent_id, kind, author, body, path, line, url FROM lightning.metastore.cartograph.provenance.discussion
     WHERE parent_id IN ('siddarth-ba-72/Interview-Prep-Pilot-AI#6') AND length(body) > 20
     ORDER BY CASE WHEN path = 'ai-service/app/llm.py' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at LIMIT 10
